newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-KEILA TERKO RAISES SHARE CAPITAL TO 13.25 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-KEILA TERKO RAISES SHARE CAPITAL TO 13.25 MLN.

text.p: Grain company Keila Terko said on Monday it had risen its share capital to 13.25 million kroons from 1.6 million kroons through a bonus share issue.
The company's financial head Priit Vakkum told Reuters that it increased the share capital from retained profits from previous years.
"Our equity had become too large compared to share capital," Vakkum said.
Shares in the wheat-flour and concentrated fodder producer are traded on the OTC market.
